objectives.text: ✗ Not met Call the MH crisis (stop sevoflurane, O₂ 100 % at 10 L/min, hyperventilate) within 120 s of the early signs (EtCO₂ above 45 mmHg at the same ventilation) The state "Trigger off: sevoflurane stopped, O₂ 100 % at 10 L/min, ventilation 20 × 600" 13 min 20 s after the state "Early signs: EtCO₂ rising at the same ventilation, tachycardia" (06:52 → 20:12; within 2 min 00 s asked).

✓ Met Give dantrolene 2.5 mg/kg within 300 s of calling the crisis Dantrolene 1 min 09 s after the state "Trigger off: sevoflurane stopped, O₂ 100 % at 10 L/min, ventilation 20 × 600" (20:12 → 21:21; within 5 min 00 s asked).
– Not assessable Repeat dantrolene 2.5 mg/kg within 600 s of the first dose while EtCO₂ is still above 45 mmHg This objective has no rule: the instructor judges it.

✗ Not met Treat the potassium (calcium chloride, insulin with dextrose) within 300 s of K⁺ rising above 5.5 mmol/L Calcium chloride 10 % or Insulin + dextrose 5 min 15 s after K⁺ above 5.5 mmol/L (17:12 → 22:26; within 5 min 00 s asked).

✓ Met Bring the ventilation back to 12 × 500 within 300 s of EtCO₂ falling below 40 mmHg The state "Ventilation back to 12 × 500, O₂ 100 %" 2 min 24 s after EtCO₂ below 40 mmHg after the state "Trigger off: sevoflurane stopped, O₂ 100 % at 10 L/min, ventilation 20 × 600" (37:43 → 40:06; within 5 min 00 s asked).
